title: AI Finding Enrichment Foundation
goal: Add the first specific AI leverage slice by storing additive finding enrichment that improves operator context without changing canonical evidence or risk fields.
scope: Implement the first AI-leverage slice as an opt-in finding-enrichment pipeline with a provider abstraction, disabled-by-default configuration, additive storage for enriched copy, and findings-surface rendering that prefers enriched context only when it exists. Keep MCP, AI mission planning, AI report drafting, and generic chat out of scope for this slice.
generation_reason: Anti-drift hardening for the repo-backed post-intake backlog.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not promote or implement this task until the current task in NEXT_TASK.md is completed and logged.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Keep this slice to opt-in finding enrichment only. Defer MCP, AI mission planning, AI report drafting, and threat-actor mapping.
notes: Never overwrite canonical severity, status, methodology, or evidence references with AI output.
Use additive storage such as ai_enrichment_json and render enriched copy only when it exists.

success_criteria: Finding enrichment is controlled by explicit configuration and remains disabled by default.
A provider abstraction supports at least a test or mock provider and one production-style adapter without requiring AI services in local tests.
Enriched business impact, technical context, and remediation narrative are stored separately from canonical finding fields.
Findings surfaces render enriched content when present and fall back cleanly when enrichment is disabled or fails.
Tests cover disabled, success, timeout or failure, and fallback behavior.

acceptance_criteria: The product behaves exactly as before when AI enrichment is disabled.
Provider failures or timeouts never block finding creation or mutate canonical finding truth.
The slice does not imply MCP or AI-assisted report writing support yet.

before_promotion: The active conversational-intake task in NEXT_TASK.md is completed, logged, and removed from active status.
python3 scripts/validate_backlog_tasks.py passes with this package still queued.
The task remains opt-in and additive rather than changing canonical finding truth.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with the AI finding-enrichment slice and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the new additive AI behavior and the larger AI backlog still pending.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md and rerun python3 scripts/validate_backlog_tasks.py.
